text:
maya_docs: FYI I opened a draft PR to harmonize function-calling examples with the structured-output guide. Looking for quick eyes before I land SDK snippets and a tiny guardrail checklist.

jon_devex: drop the link? want to skim the compact example shape.

maya_docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4278 - summary: new compact "envelope" pattern, tolerant-parser example, and a short guardrail callout box.

ravi_ml: nice. can we explicitly show handling of missing optional keys and nulls? folks keep getting JSON.parse failures when models omit properties.

maya_docs: yes plan to add a tiny tolerant example that falls back to { _raw } when parse fails. also will show schema that marks fields as nullable.

alice-sdk: I will update TS and Python snippets to SDK v1.9 in this branch. I'll add a helper: ```ts
function parseOrKeepRaw(s: string) {
  try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch { return { _raw: s }; }
}
```

link-checker-bot: Found 1 broken anchor in PR 4278: /guides/structured-output#old-id -> 404.

maya_docs: fixed anchors and renamed compact example id to #compact-envelope to be explicit.

jon_devex: for the guardrails box, keep it punchy: 1) require a small top-level discriminator (type/action), 2) prefer nullable keys in schema, 3) always log raw output on parse failures. One line each.

ravi_ml: add a one-liner about token budget: recommend summarizing long free-text fields client-side before sending.

alice-sdk: pushed snippets and tiny readme note linking to SDK changelog.

link-checker-bot: Recheck complete  no broken links remaining.

maya_docs: thanks all. action items: Alice finalize snippets, Ravi add the model-behavior note, Jon copyedit guardrail bullets. Will merge after CI green.

jon_devex: happy to review final wording.

maya_docs: will tag reviewers when ready. :tada:
